name: Connecticut

laws.summary: Give OPM power to set IT policy for state agencies, including this accessibility policy.

laws.cite: 28 C.F.R. Part 35, Subpart H (ADA Title II web and mobile rule, 2024; dates extended by DOJ interim final rule 2026-04-20)
laws.summary: State and local governments must make web content and mobile apps conform to WCAG 2.1 AA.

policy_docs.title: State of Connecticut Accessibility & Inclusivity Policy for Websites and Digital Assets v5.0 (OPM, 2025-07-14)

applies_to: State agencies as defined in C.G.S. § 4d-1(3); the legislature and judiciary are encouraged but not required to adopt it.

deadlines.what: Policy v5.0 effective; all new digital content must meet WCAG 2.1 AA
Federal ADA Title II floor: public entities with population 50,000+ must meet WCAG 2.1 AA (extended from 2026-04-24)
Federal ADA Title II floor: entities under 50,000 and special districts (extended from 2027-04-26)

requires: Designate an Accessibility Designee as single point of contact
Build all new content to WCAG 2.1 AA
Prioritize remediation of existing content by user impact
procurement: Accessibility requirements must be addressed in contracts with vendors who create digital content.
enforcement: Complaints go to the agency's Accessibility Designee (or Customer Success Manager) or the Statewide Accessibility Feedback form run by DAS BITS.
notes: v5.0 replaced the Universal Website Accessibility Policy v4.1 (2019). No statutory private remedy specific to digital accessibility was found. office_url comes from search results and was not opened. Federal floor: ADA Title II rule (WCAG 2.1 AA, web + mobile apps) applies to all state and local government regardless of state law; DOJ's 2026-04-20 interim final rule moved compliance dates to 2027-04-26 / 2028-04-26.
